name: 2fast
description: Tray-first desktop OTP polling utility for API and IMAP email accounts.
author: 2Fast contributors

scripts.dev: tsc -b src/main/tsconfig.json && tsc -b src/preload/tsconfig.json && concurrently -k "vite --config vite.config.ts" "tsc -b src/main/tsconfig.json --watch" "tsc -b src/preload/tsconfig.json --watch" "electron ."
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run clean && vite build --config vite.config.ts && tsc -b src/main/tsconfig.json && tsc -b src/preload/tsconfig.json
scripts.dist: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run clean:release && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.verify: tsc -b src/shared/tsconfig.json src/main/tsconfig.json src/preload/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && eslint . && vitest run
